name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.

name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.

blocks.text:
name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done

    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.

blocks.text:
name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:

      - '**.freezed.dart'

  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true

name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.

name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800

    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true

name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.

name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.

name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch dmtools-agents from git MAIN into agents/ for integration tests.
#
# Owner decision 2026-10-15: the agents/ submodule pin is GONE — the
# integration surface (L4 suite, wiring tests) always runs against the
# dmtools-agents MAIN tip, fetched fresh. No lockstep duty, no stale pins.
#
# - AGENTS_FETCH_REF overrides the ref (default: main).
# - AGENTS_FETCH_DIR overrides the target (default: agents/).
# - A pre-existing agents/ tree is REPLACED (always-fresh semantics);
#   pass AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1 to reuse an existing checkout.
set -euo pipefail

REF="${AGENTS_FETCH_REF:-main}"
DIR="${AGENTS_FETCH_DIR:-agents}"
URL="${AGENTS_FETCH_URL:-https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git}"

if [[ "${AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP:-0}" == "1" && -d "$DIR/.git" ]]; then
  echo "[fetch-agents] $DIR already present (AGENTS_FETCH_KEEP=1) — reusing"
  exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] cloning $URL @ $REF -> $DIR"
# Keep .git (depth-1 clone): the L4 suite's docs-coverage tests answer
# real `git ls-files` calls from the fetched tree's index.
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$REF" "$URL" "$DIR"
echo "[fetch-agents] $(find "$DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files at $(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

# crap4dart configuration.
# See https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart for details.

# Directories scanned for Dart sources by "analyze" and "check"
# (default mode, without --changed/--staged).
# GOAL.md: test code is held to the same bar.
sources: [lib, bin, test]

# Files excluded from analysis in every mode (glob patterns relative
# to the project root).
# exclude: ['example/**', 'tool/**', '**.g.dart']

# CRAP metric analysis settings ("analyze" command).
crap:
  # Enable CRAP analysis; when false, "analyze" exits immediately.
  enabled: true
  # Maximum allowed CRAP score; higher scores fail the run.
  threshold: 8.0
  # Run the test suite to generate coverage before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Count branches inside lambdas towards the enclosing method's
  # cyclomatic complexity.
  # count_lambdas: true

# Coverage input settings.
coverage:
  # Path to the LCOV coverage file, relative to the project root.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  # Run "dart test --coverage" / "flutter test --coverage" before analyzing.
  run_tests: false
  # Fail when no coverage data is available instead of reporting N/A.
  required: true
  # Report branch coverage (BRDA records) in addition to line coverage.
  branch_coverage: true

# Quality gates ("check" command).
gates:
  # Limit file size in lines of code.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    # Maximum lines per file.
    max_lines: 800
    # Glob patterns excluded from the gate.
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
  # Enforce a minimum test coverage percentage.
  test_coverage:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum required coverage percent.
    min_percent: 80.0
    # Apply the minimum per file instead of to the project total.
    per_file: false
    # Directories whose files count towards the coverage aggregate.
    dirs: [lib]
  # Enforce golden (screenshot) tests for widgets (Flutter projects).
  golden:
    enabled: true
    # Minimum percentage of widgets with a matching golden test.
